'''Robin Mayne''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 111 from Edmonton, Ab. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
